action_timeline.rationale: Enter during the predicted Melantha-targeted artillery cooldown; do not infer cancellation of its born projectile.
Requires artillery dead, its projectiles resolved, and final approach duty handed to the existing blockers.

battle_phases.completion_condition: Hibiscus is legally deployed at frame 1923 with all four blockers alive.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: A dead blocker or missed cooldown handoff invalidates later income, healing and interception assumptions.
battle_phases.goal: Establish four living interceptions and reach the delayed lower medical entry.
handoff_requirements: Observe the Melantha-targeted artillery cast and born projectile before Hibiscus enters.
Hibiscus assumes lower recovery without becoming the next artillery target.
responsibilities: Vanilla and Friston intercept the central runners; Vanilla's DOWN range assists upper-central attacks while she is unoccupied.
Earlier Midnight supports central clearance before taking upper-outer traffic.
Melantha establishes lower-outer blocking and attacks its eastern roadblock between enemies.
Ansel restores the upper group before sustained pressure.
battle_phases.start_condition: Stage begins with 10 DP and no deployed operators.
survival_dependencies: The two conditional Vanilla grants occur.
Earlier central damage preserves Friston until Ansel arrives.
Vanilla and Melantha survive their first engagements without lower healing.

battle_phases.completion_condition: Artillery is dead, its born projectiles have resolved, and eastern roadblocks #3 and #4 are destroyed.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: Artillery survival or an unopened eastern passage leaves protected targets exposed and prevents project acceptance.
battle_phases.goal: Kill artillery and release both eastern civilian passages.
handoff_requirements: Keep all four lane blockers deployed after artillery dies.
Convert Steward's released attacks into approach damage; source death alone does not clear projectiles.
responsibilities: Steward maintains highest-defense artillery targeting.
Ansel's first boost sustains Steward through repeated impacts.
Hibiscus heals the actual lower recipients from [5,2].
Midnight and Melantha clear eastern roadblocks whenever opposing enemies do not take priority.
battle_phases.start_condition: Western Hibiscus has entered and eastern Steward is affordable.
survival_dependencies: Melantha survives the first lower impact and receives enough healing before another.
Steward receives sufficiently frequent healing despite upper competition.
Artillery dies before it can repeatedly attack the western waiting civilian.

battle_phases.completion_condition: Late runner pairs are killed without exceeding either holder's capacity, and final spawns are exhausted.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: Overflow causes an immediate leak; later caster redeployment cannot repair project acceptance.
battle_phases.goal: Clear first armor while maintaining capacity for paired late runners.
handoff_requirements: At frame 6390, surviving blockers must be able to contain every remaining enemy during Steward's cooldown.
No ranged contact is counted as physical blocking.
responsibilities: Friston supplies three upper slots; Vanilla supplies two lower slots.
Midnight's second arts window attacks central armor whenever upper self-blocked enemies permit.
Steward stays eastern to damage approaching armor and runners through the final spawns.
Both medics sustain their assigned holders and outer blockers.
battle_phases.start_condition: First central armor appears at frames 4380 and 4530.
survival_dependencies: Lower capacity is available before the second runner near frame 5932.
Midnight's self-blocked priority does not consume too much of the decisive central damage window.
Actual approach damage reduces the held backlog sufficiently.

battle_phases.completion_condition: No hostile enemies or hostile projectiles remain before the western withdrawals.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: Premature withdrawals release enemies; deaths or unfinished armor invalidate the fixed western schedule.
battle_phases.goal: Finish held final armor with a legal caster rotation.
handoff_requirements: Verify hostile and projectile clearance before frames 9600 and 9601.
Keep civilian protection separate from hostile kill accounting.
responsibilities: Four blockers and both medics remain active throughout the caster cooldown.
Midnight's third arts window resumes central armor damage.
Steward returns at [2,6] UP and directly covers both holder tiles.
battle_phases.start_condition: Steward withdraws at frame 6390 after final approach duty.
survival_dependencies: The holders survive final armor until concentrated arts damage resumes.
Steward's withdrawal is living and his redeployment is legal.

battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: An intact western restraint prevents safe arrival even if all hostiles are dead.
battle_phases.goal: Remove both western restraints without abandoning active combat.
handoff_requirements: Leave the civilians free to follow their source routes.
Wait for two distinct safe-arrival events.
responsibilities: Redeploy Steward at [2,2] DOWN after 2101 frames.
Redeploy Melantha at [6,3] LEFT after her separate 2101-frame interval.
Attack roadblocks, never neutral civilians.
battle_phases.start_condition: Hostile clearance permits the living withdrawals at frames 9600 and 9601.
survival_dependencies: Both rotating operators are available and affordable.
No hostile or residual artillery threat remains.

battle_phases.completion_condition: Remaining life is positive, leaks and protected deaths are zero, spawns are exhausted, no active enemies remain, and both protected targets have safely arrived.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: Any missing acceptance condition means the plan has not achieved the project objective.
battle_phases.goal: Confirm complete stage and protected-target success.
handoff_requirements: Do not report success from hostile clearance or one civilian arrival alone.
responsibilities: Count the two protected arrivals individually.
Record operator deaths separately and retain all objective counters.
battle_phases.start_condition: All four roadblocks are destroyed and both civilian routes are open.
survival_dependencies: Both protected targets remain alive until their own objectives.

corridor_responsibilities.responsibility: Steward kills artillery while Ansel sustains him. Melantha absorbs the first lower cast; delayed western Hibiscus avoids subsequent acquisition. Born projectiles remain dangerous after source death.

Midnight destroys eastern roadblock #3 between hostile engagements. Steward later destroys western roadblock #1. Midnight intercepts pursuing officers; ordinary operators neither attack nor block the civilian.
Melantha destroys eastern roadblock #4 and later western roadblock #2. Keep lower officers intercepted while the civilian crosses.

Friston physically blocks upper-central traffic. Ansel heals him; available Vanilla and Midnight attacks clear occupants. Steward supplies approach damage, then direct holder coverage after redeployment.
Vanilla physically blocks lower-central traffic. Hibiscus heals her after the delayed entry. Midnight and Steward must reduce armor and runner backlog before two slots are exceeded.
Midnight blocks upper-outer traffic under Ansel. His self-blocked enemies take priority over central assistance.
Melantha blocks and clears lower-outer traffic under Hibiscus. Her one-block capacity requires sequential kills, especially the ten-second pair.

deployment_positions_and_directions.role: Lower-central two-block interception, upper-central assistance while unoccupied, manual income.
Upper-outer interception, both central holders' available damage, eastern upper roadblock clearance.
Lower-outer interception, eastern lower roadblock clearance, first lower artillery recipient.
Heal Friston, Midnight, eastern Steward and himself.
Heal Vanilla, Melantha and herself from the western lower tile.
Artillery damage, followed by central approach damage.
After a legal rotation, damage enemies held by both central blockers.

artillery_damage_budget.basis: Supported Steward ATK talent gives 498.2 ATK; artillery RES50 gives 249.1 ordinary and 473.29 enhanced damage.
artillery_damage_budget.limitations: This arithmetic does not prove continuous contact, delivery, recipient healing or kill time. No Midnight air damage is credited.
artillery_damage_budget.prediction: Eastern contact beginning near 76 seconds can finish artillery near 147 seconds.
artillery_damage_budget.requirement: Forty-five landed attacks, including nine enhanced attacks, exceed 13000 HP. At uninterrupted 1.6-second cadence they span 70.4 seconds from first strike.

economy.conditions: Both opening grants require living, deployed Vanilla and successful manual activations. The third grant occurs after Steward's deployment and is not used to fund it.
economy.redeployment: Current executor charges Steward 18 and Melantha 15 again. Each scheduled redeployment follows its own withdrawal by 2101 frames. Client cost escalation is not inferred.
economy.refund_accounting: Refunds are floor(paid cost/2), capped by 99 DP; under the survival hypothesis these late refunds are clipped at the cap and are unnecessary for affordability. Death refunds zero.

medical_partition.limits: Healing remains subject to missing-HP ratios and attack cadence. No extra-heal, dodge or unsupported talent is credited.
medical_partition.verification: Read-only range calculations confirm all listed recipients, including both central holders from Steward's later [2,6] UP position.

formation_structure.opening: Vanilla starts lower-central; Friston starts upper-central. Vanilla's first ATK-and-DP activation funds earlier Midnight support. Melantha establishes lower-outer blocking before its first runner. Ansel enters first; Hibiscus enters west during the first lower artillery cooldown.
formation_structure.validation: Read-only geometry, opening DP and manual-SP arithmetic checked. No simulation or file mutation performed.

formation_transitions.transition: Vanilla's first activation funds Midnight and strengthens the opening central kill window.
Ansel takes responsibility for upper-central Friston and upper-outer Midnight.
Hibiscus enters [5,2] after the predicted Melantha-targeted lower cast has begun and its projectile has been born.
Steward establishes eastern artillery contact before the lower eastern wait.
Midnight's second arts window supports central armor and late runners; self-blocked upper officers can interrupt this duty.
After final-spawn approach damage, living Steward withdraws for the central firing rotation.
Steward returns at [2,6] UP, now covering both central blocking tiles.
After hostile and projectile clearance, Steward withdraws for western upper roadblock clearance.
After the lower outer route is empty, living Melantha withdraws for western lower roadblock clearance.
Steward returns west after his full cooldown.
Melantha returns west after her own full cooldown.

mandatory_tactical_invariants.requirement: Exactly seven distinct selected/deployed IDs, all catalog normal-mode rarity 1-3. No reserve units or hidden aliases.
All DEPLOY tiles are integer [row,col] with cardinal directions. Never deploy on [[1,2],[6,2],[1,6],[6,6]].
Vanilla must survive both opening income activations. A missing grant caused by death or failed handoff is a tactical failure, not an arithmetic correction.
The first lower cast must select Melantha before Hibiscus enters. Its five-second cooldown must persist, and artillery must leave [5,2]'s acquisition radius before the next selection.
Vanilla and Melantha must survive until frame 1923. Hibiscus must deliver recipient-specific recovery before repeated lower impacts become lethal.

Friston and Vanilla remain living blockers. Range contact does not substitute for interception. Lower occupancy must remain below two before each new arrival, including the second late runner near frame 5932.
Steward must survive and finish artillery before western protected-target acquisition. Forty-five landed attacks are a budget, not a guaranteed kill event.

Deaths release blocked enemies and refund zero. No death is credited as useful unless its actual damage, absorbed attack, cooldown consumption and successor coverage are recorded. This fixed plan has no automatic death-redeployment branch.
Retreat only living deployed operators after their stated handoffs. Scheduled redeployments use real executor cost and cooldown; failure of a retreat precondition refutes this fixed schedule.
Require remaining_life > 0, zero leaks, exhausted spawns, no active enemies, zero protected-target deaths and two distinct safe protected-target arrivals. Operator deaths are recorded separately.

pressure_window_responsibilities.duties: Establish four interceptions. Earlier Midnight and Vanilla's opening buff must preserve both central blockers. Until Hibiscus enters, lower Vanilla and Melantha rely on HP and clearance.
Deliver timely lower healing, clear eastern roadblocks, sustain eastern Steward and kill artillery before western civilian acquisition.
Clear first central armor and preserve blocking slots through paired runners. This is the principal unresolved combat risk.
Keep four blockers and both medical streams deployed during Steward's cooldown. Hold final armor without releasing enemies.
Combine central Steward with Midnight's third arts window to finish held armor and verify hostile clearance.
Perform legal western rotations, remove both remaining roadblocks and observe both protected targets safely arrive.

skill_intents.intent: Manual six-DP grants and ten-second ATK boosts. Every activation requires Vanilla alive and deployed; thirty-second cycles include active-time SP pause.
Ordinary blocking and damage only; no robot talent is credited.
First arts window advances eastern clearance and central fights; second addresses armor and late runners; third finishes held armor. No air damage.
Boost paired lower officers, later outer pressure and cleanup. Initial roadblock clearance uses ordinary attacks.
Boost lower recovery around the central artillery hit, first armor, runner overlap and final armor. Ordinary healing continues between skills.
Place the first boost across Steward's first sustained artillery exposure, then support upper armor pressure. No probabilistic extra healing.
Automatic enhanced attacks and supported highest-defense priority. Remain eastern through final approach duties before rotating.

tactical_thesis: Replace Fang with Vanilla, move Friston into the upper medical stream, and delay western Hibiscus until Melantha has drawn the first lower artillery cast. Preserve four actual lane interceptions. Sustain eastern Steward through artillery clearance, retain his approach damage through the final spawns, then rotate him into central firing range. This is a complete CURRENT_MODEL_CHECKABLE hypothesis, not a verified WIN.
